definition: Zip a skill folder into a single uploadable skill file for upload or hand-off.
outcome: a single skill file containing the skill directory exists, ready to upload or hand to someone else; it is not installed anywhere

records.outcome: a ZIP file containing the skill directory itself exists, ready to upload to Claude
preconditions: a skill directory with SKILL.md exists
steps: Ensure the directory name matches the skill's name field
Create a ZIP file containing the skill directory, not its files at the ZIP root

evidence.quote: Create a ZIP file containing the skill directory
